idea-plugin.name: KubeContext Safety
idea-plugin.description:
KubeContext Safety

One wrong kubectl command in the wrong context can take down production. KubeContext Safety adds a color-coded context indicator to your IDE status bar and blocks destructive commands in production environments — giving your team a critical safety net.

Key Features

  • Status Bar Widget — Always-visible current kubectl context with environment label
  • Color-Coded Environments — Red for production, yellow for staging, green for development
  • Production Guard — Confirmation dialog before any command in production contexts
  • Quick Context Switching — Switch kubectl contexts from the status bar without terminal commands
  • Team Rules — Share context classifications via .k8s-guard.yaml in your repo
  • Namespace Awareness — Context safety extends to namespace-level operations

Why KubeContext Safety?

Production incidents caused by wrong-context kubectl commands are more common than anyone admits. This plugin adds a simple but effective guardrail that has prevented countless accidental deployments and deletions.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Status bar widget, color-coded contexts, production guard, quick switching, team config
  • Pro: Audit logging, command allowlists/blocklists per context, Slack/Teams notifications for production access, and multi-cluster dashboard
